_comment: Exercise demo animation corrections for the Turquoise AI app. Key = exercise name in any language (case, punctuation and hyphens are ignored), value = media file id served from /exercise-media/<id>.gif, or "-" to show no animation for that exercise. The app re-reads this file once a day, so corrections take effect without an app update. Example: { "military press": "aB3xYz1", "face pull": "-" }
